A first stop before [Classic Sequencers Compared](sequencer-compare.qmd). Short sections, one idea each. Click a heading to fold or open it.

::: {.ik-do}
**What you'll do**

1. Read what the Elektron-style sequencer is and when it was made.
2. Learn its sound, one idea at a time.
3. Take a guided tour: press each **▶ Hear step** button and listen for one change.
4. Find records it is on.
5. Check yourself with a short quiz.
:::

## What it is

- **Elektron** is a company from Gothenburg, Sweden (Wikipedia, "Elektron (company)"). The **Digitakt II** came out in **2024** (Wikipedia).
- Its sequencer has a row of steps; a step with a note on it is a **trig** (Digitakt II manual, p. 41).
- **Parameter locks** let one step change a setting just for itself (manual, p. 47). Elektron started them on the 2002 Machinedrum (Wikipedia).
- Elektron users named by Wikipedia include Thom Yorke, Sophie and Depeche Mode.

## Its sound

- A **note trig** plays a note; a **lock trig** changes settings without playing (manual, p. 41).
- **Micro timing** pushes one trig a little early or late (manual, p. 45).
- **Trig conditions** play a trig only on some loops, such as 1:2 = loops 1, 3, 5 … (manual, p. 48).
- **Swing** runs from 51 % to 80 % (manual, p. 23).

## Check yourself

Click an answer. You will see at once if it is right. Nothing is saved or sent.

```{=html}
<div class="ik-q" data-a="0"><p><b>A parameter lock…</b></p><ul><li>Changes a setting on one step only</li><li>Locks the machine</li><li>Stops the tempo</li><li>Saves to tape</li></ul><p class="ik-why">Manual p. 47.</p></div>
<div class="ik-q" data-a="0"><p><b>Trig condition 1:2 plays on…</b></p><ul><li>Loops 1, 3, 5 …</li><li>Every loop</li><li>No loops</li><li>Only loop 2</li></ul><p class="ik-why">Manual p. 48.</p></div>
<div class="ik-q" data-a="0"><p><b>Micro timing moves a trig…</b></p><ul><li>A little early or late</li><li>To another song</li><li>An octave up</li><li>Into the reverb</li></ul><p class="ik-why">Manual p. 45.</p></div>
<div class="ik-q" data-a="0"><p><b>A lock trig…</b></p><ul><li>Changes settings without playing a note</li><li>Plays the loudest note</li><li>Ends the pattern</li><li>Is a drum</li></ul><p class="ik-why">Manual p. 41.</p></div>
```
